thread:
laura_pm: quick intake — problem statement + high-level goals for a new feature: predictive prompt caching. customers report repeated semantically-similar prompts causing token/cost spikes and inconsistent latency. want an approach that caches or rewrites requests to avoid redundant model work while preserving fidelity and safety.

laura_pm: context: a couple of mid-market customers (chatbots + summarizers) have ~25% token duplication across sessions. they want cost relief without moving to lower-capacity models.

laura_pm: goals:
- reduce per-tenant token cost for repeated prompts by >=20% on representative workloads
- keep end-user visible regressions <1% by our eval suite (semantic-similarity & factuality checks)
- rollout path: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> full with kill-switch and automatic rollback

laura_pm: non-goals:
- not replacing model selection/routing policies (this is a layer that augments requests prior to inference)
- not doing model-distillation or training changes

laura_pm: success metrics (proposal):
- cost: delta token spend per 100k requests vs baseline (target -20%)
- quality: eval-suite pass rate delta <= 1 percentage point
- latency: P95 additional processing < 30ms for cache-lookup+rewrite path
- safety: zero new safety alerts in daily monitor for 7-day canary

devin_eng: question — do we mean exact request hashing or semantic keys? caching exact tokens is easy but won't catch paraphrases.

anya_research: we should use a semantic fingerprint (embedding or hashed prompt-normalized form). propose a two-tier cache: exact->fast, semantic->approx with a similarity threshold. need eval harness to measure false positives (served cached vs should re-run).

michael_sre: infra constraints: Dedicated customers with isolated pools will need local cache or per-tenant namespace. invalidation is the hard part (tenant model updates, prompt context changes). we should define TTL defaults and an explicit invalidation API.

kai_product_ops: privacy note — cached outputs might contain PII. require KMS-backed encryption at-rest for cached payloads and opt-out flag per-tenant.

laura_pm: proposed acceptance criteria for MVP:
- implementation of exact-key cache + optional semantic-key plugin (configurable per-tenant)
- cache config UI fields: TTL, enabled (true/false), similarity threshold slider (if semantic enabled)
- eval harness results: <=1% quality regression on tenant-provided test set and public eval set
- observability: per-tenant cache hit rate, hit-quality delta, cost-savings estimate chart, and alert thresholds
- safety controls: opt-out + encryption + audit log entries for cache hits serving content with potential PII markers

devin_eng: tech note: semantic-key requires an embedding call unless we compute a cheap fingerprint. embedding adds cost; might defeat cost savings. we can precompute embeddings for known prompt templates or run batched embedding lookups. need perf budget.

anya_research: add to eval: measure latency and embedding-cost tradeoff. For canary, run semantic mode but don't bill savings until validated.

michael_sre: edge cases: streaming responses (partial outputs), function-calling responses, multi-turn context where earlier messages change the meaning, tenants that use ephemeral prompt tokens (like timestamps). need rules to skip cache if prompt contains dynamic tokens or functions.

laura_pm: explicit edge-case non-goals and guardrails:
- skip caching for requests flagged as "ephemeral" by SDK header
- skip caching for requests using function calls or streaming mode
- cache key normalization must remove timestamps/nonce-looking tokens via heuristics (we'll add to docs)

kai_product_ops: rollout gating / abort conditions:
- if eval-suite quality drop >1.5% for 24h -> auto rollback
- if customer reports >3 related tickets in 72h during canary -> pause for that tenant and escalate

laura_pm: next asks:
- @devin_eng can you draft a short tech approach doc listing exact vs semantic cache, API hooks for invalidation, and perf estimates?
- @anya_research can you add eval cases and a small script to measure false-positive cache hits?
- @michael_sre please enumerate infra requirements for Dedicated vs Hosted (storage, encryption, TTL enforcement)
- @kai_product_ops I'll add the UI fields and rollout plan to the PRD.

devin_eng: will do. planning to sketch a PoC that uses exact-key + templated fingerprinting first. ETA EOW.

anya_research: will put together an eval harness + 3 small prompt corpora (support chat, summarization, codegen) to test.

michael_sre: I'll scope storage + ops runbook. also propose a canary monitor dashboard (cache-hit vs error-rate).

laura_pm: thanks. created PRD doc draft: https://redwood.internal/docs/prd/predictive-prompt-caching (internal). please add comments to the PRD and I'll schedule a 30min sync next Tue.

deploy-bot: PR created by laura_pm: <https://git.redwood/repo/prs/1234|predictive-prompt-caching-prd> :white_check_mark:

kai_product_ops: quick note — we should include a simple customer-facing FAQ about what is cached and opt-out instructions.

laura_pm: added that to the PRD. tagging this thread as 'intake' and moving to backlog with priority P2 pending EOW tech sketches.
